solicitations.title: Embassy Libreville, Gabon - Request for Quotations (RFQ) for trash collection services
solicitations.description: DESCRIPTION: The Embassy of the United States in Gabon is launching its solicitation on the SAM.gov website. The purpose of this fixed price contract is to obtain trash collection services for the U.S. Government at Libreville. The Contractor shall perform services in designated spaces. The anticipated performance period is for a base year, with three one-year option periods, if exercised by the Government. All responsible sources may submit a quotation, which will be considered. The guidelines for registration in SAM are also available at: https://www.fsd.gov/fsd-gov/learning-center-system.do?sysparm_system=SAM This opportunity is subject to 52.229-12 Tax on Certain Foreign Procurements (FEB 2021) Electronic Submission/Responses: This opportunity allows for electronic responses. solicitations.title: 6515--541-26-3-250-0496 - UltraSAFE Automatic Formalin Dispensing  System  Brand Name Only Small Business set-aside
solicitations.description: Combined Synopsis/Solicitation Notice *= Required Field Combined Synopsis/Solicitation Notice DESCRIPTION This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) subpart 12.6, Streamlined Procedures for Evaluation and Solicitation for Commercial Items, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; quotes are being requested, and a written solicitation document will not be issued. This solicitation is issued as an RFQ. The solicitation document and incorporated provisions and clauses are those in effect through Federal Acquisition Circular 2023-01. This solicitation is a Brand Name Only Small Business set-aside. The associated North American Industrial Classification System (NAICS) code for this procurement is 333914. The FSC/PSC is 6515. The NCO 10 for Cleveland VA Medical Center is seeking to purchase the UltraSAFE Unit: Automatic Formalin Dispensing System for the Surgical Department. This solicitation closes on September 24, 2026 @ 16:00 PM. Quotes should be submitted to Kevin Peeples kevin.peeples@va.gov Please reference 36C25026Q1068 1. Contracting Officer s Representative (COR) NA 2. CONTRACT TITLE: UltraSAFE Unit: Automatic Formalin Dispensing System 3. BACKGROUND The VA Northeast Ohio Healthcare System (VANEOHS) is requesting the purchase of Brand Name Only, UltraSafe formalin dispensing system to include all accessories included with purchase. This system will allow Cleveland VAMC to be compliant with VA guidelines and have the equipment to keep our veterans and OR staff safe in case of a Formalin spill. There have been issues with the current hood system and PPE being used and the new system will address all issues. The Safety Department performed a walk-thru in the OR and a safety concern was raised by the safety department because of a lack of an Ultrasafe Formalin Dispenser. Not having this UltraSafe dispense could cause harm to patients/OR staff if Formalin spills and is not handled properly Cleveland VAMC is the only surgical facility in the VISN that does not have one. 4. SCOPE Government market research and justification studies consistently indicate that the UltraSAFE system occupies a unique Brand Name Only operational niche. It regularly outcompetes alternative or manual methods due to a proprietary, fully enclosed ecosystem. Proprietary Valve Technology: It utilizes custom buckets designed with a non-return quadricuspid safety valve, allowing automatic injection of formalin without letting toxic fumes escape. Traceability Integration: Unlike generic chemical dispensers, it features built-in scales, barcode readers, and thermal printers to automate documentation, recording the exact tissue weight, time to fixation, and formalin volume. Independent Infrastructure: Features built-in charcoal and HEPA filters, allowing it to function as a standalone unit without requiring expensive modifications to a facility's external HVAC or exhaust lines. The Purchase of the UltraSAFE Unit will allow Cleveland VAMC OR department to be compliant with VA guidelines also have the equipment needed to keep our veterans and OR staff safe in case of a Formalin spill there have been issues with the hood system and PPE being used and this new system would address all those concerns. 5. Specific Tasks UltraSafe is the only system that could meet all needs. It is a zero-formalin exposure it will fill .5L containers and print off labels with employee info and sample information. All the other manufacturers researched could not meet these needs. The item MUST have the following: Fully ventilated enclosure Have items automated by weight Label print & LIMS Data Zero operator Fume escape UltraSafe is a proprietary system manufactured and exclusively supplied by Milestone Medical. UltraSafe is the only system that could meet all needs of a zero-formalin exposure system that prints off labels with employee and sample info and the entire operation is also fume-free. Core Safety Characteristics: Enclosed & Vented Chamber: The entire dispensing process happens inside an auto-locking, fully enclosed chamber equipped with charcoal and HEPA H14 filters. This design removes the need to hook the workstation into external building ventilation lines Patented One-Way Valve Lids: Specimens are placed into custom buckets that seal immediately. The system uses an automatic injection nozzle that penetrates a special quadricuspid valve in the lid to inject the fluid, ensuring fumes cannot escape and preventing any backflow or spillages Weight-Based Automated Dispensing: The unit features a built-in scale. It detects the weight of the biospecimen and automatically dispenses the perfect volume of formalin to match preset laboratory ratios (e.g., a 1:3 specimen-to-fixative ratio) Data Logging & Traceability: A built-in barcode reader logs bucket IDs and case numbers. An integrated thermal printer automatically outputs detailed labels recording the specimen weight, exact formalin volume, and the precise time to fixation to maintain a strict chain of custody 6. Performance Monitoring Biomedical Engineering staff will work with warehouse staff to ensure delivery and incoming inspection to determine fitness for use. 7. Security Requirements The requirements do not apply; The contractor will not have access to VA sensitive information. 8. Government-Furnished Equipment (GFE)/Government-Furnished Information (GFI). There will be no government-Furnished equipment of information. 9. Other Pertinent Information or Special Considerations. The requested equipment shall be interoperable/usable with current workflows and technology deployed and used within the clinical atmosphere and existing BX Microscopes and associated accessories. a. Identification of Possible Follow-on Work. NA b. Identification of Potential Conflicts of Interest (COI). NA c. Identification of Non-Disclosure Requirements. NA d. Packaging, Packing and Shipping Instructions. NA e. Inspection and Acceptance Criteria. Biomedical Engineering staff will work with warehouse staff to ensure delivery and incoming inspection to determine fitness for use. 10. Risk Control The Surgical Service will follow any safety recommendations given by the vendor and Biomed for the equipment. 11. Place of Performance. Delivery Location: Louis Stokes Cleveland VA Medical Center 10701 East Boulevard Cleveland, OH 44106 12. Period of Performance NA 13. Delivery Schedule. One time buy SUBMISSION Responses to this solicitation shall be submitted via email to kevin.peeples@va.gov. Telephone responses shall not be accepted. Responses must be received no later than September 24 2026, at 16:00 pm EST, (Eastern Standard Time). solicitations.description: This is a Request for Quotations (RFQ) issued by the U.S. Embassy Brasília, Brazil, under the simplified procedures at FAR 12.201-1. Solicitation number PR16211477. A purchase order will be issued to the successful quoter. 1. Requirement: Scott Paper Towel Roll, 12 x 270 m — 212 boxes. Single-ply roll, 100% virgin fiber, basis weight 33–37 g/m², sheet width 200 mm, roll diameter 185–195 mm, 270 m per roll, white, FSC® certified, packed 12 rolls per box. The quoter must also furnish, on loan at no cost to the Government, the dispensers compatible with this roll format. Brand names are cited for descriptive purposes only to establish form, fit, and function. Quotations offering an equal product will be considered if accompanied by technical data sufficient to establish equality against each characteristic above. 2. Delivery: DDP to the U.S. Embassy Brasília CMPD and Warehouse, Brasília-DF, Brazil. Inspection and acceptance at destination. Quoters must state delivery time in calendar days after receipt of order. 3. Pricing: Quote in Brazilian Reais (BRL), inclusive of all taxes, freight, and handling. Minimum quotation validity: 30 calendar days. 4. Basis for award: Lowest evaluated price among quotations meeting the technical and delivery requirements. The Government may award without discussions and may reject any or all quotations. 5. Quotations are due 24 September 2026, 8:00 p.m. Brasília local time (UTC−3) , by email to BrasiliaGSOProcurementDL@state.gov. and VieiraFS@state.gov This solicitation incorporates provisions and clauses by reference. The full text is available at www.acquisition.gov.

solicitations.title: Posi-Turner: Model numbers – 10LS-250 or equal to
solicitations.description: Purchase Description (PD) Position Turner for Large Hulls Surface Support Division, B343 Shop Red River Army Depot (RRAD) Texarkana, TX 75507-5000 11 August 2026 1.0 Scope. This PD is to define the specifications necessary to award a contract for a 1 EA Position(Posi)-Turner: Model numbers – 10LS-250 or equal to, will be for the Directorate for Maintenance in the Welding Shop section, Bldg. 343 in support of the Bradley/MLRS fleet expansion effort. Contractor shall perform any/all site preparation needed for new equipment. Site preparation may include delivery of new equipment, offloading and positioning of new equipment, planning and designing, fabrication, and commissioning necessary to furnish one Posi-Turner to the Welding Shop. 2.0 Requirements. The following salient characteristics are the minimum requirements for any proposed items being offered: Capacity: 10,000 lbs. - Unit includes the "Leveler" that adjusts the center-of-gravity under the hook to balance the load with pushbutton control - Bail adjusts 6" +/- either side of center (bail = 4.3" x 7.5") - Maximum sling spacing: 251" - Minimum sling spacing: 14.25" - Heavy duty non-slip surface on drum - Heavy duty drive package - Power required: 460/3/60 (power to be supplied from crane) - Includes operator pendant with 20'-0 cord. - System to be used with a single crane/hoist hook - Estimated unit weight: 4765 lbs. - Estimated system height: 49" (base to hook) - Painted standard Caldwell yellow - Meets ASME B30.20, BTH-1 design standards; design category "B", service class "2". 3.0 Installation Schedule. The Posi-Turner shall be delivered, installed and operational at building 343, Red River Army Depot. RRAD works a four-day, ten-hour workweek, Mon-Thurs, 0630-1700. Working Friday is not guaranteed but will be taken into consideration. The contractor may request to work Friday with 48 hours prior notice to RRAD POC. RRAD will be closed on all Federal Holidays which are: New Year’s Day Martin Luther King Birthday President’s Day Memorial Day Juneteenth Independence Day Labor Day Columbus Day Veteran’s Day Thanksgiving Day Christmas Day 4.0 Final Acceptance Testing A final acceptance run-off shall be performed. The runoff shall demonstrate the system’s ability to lift, roll over, and position 2 EA MLRS Hulls without failure. The test shall consist of the designed by RRAD personnel with no failures. Government will furnish the MLRS Hulls for the final acceptance testing 5.0 Technical Manuals Technical Manuals and Parts List: Contractor shall provide two (2) hard copies and one electronic copy on CD/DVD of operations sequence, system program, Bill of Materials (BOM), wiring diagrams/schematics, maintenance manuals for contractor installed equipment including calibration information and procedures where applicable. all operator and maintenance manuals. Set and level the machine components on its foundation. () (XX) c. Provide and install anchor bolts and nuts. () (XX) d. Connect machine to the provided utilities hook-up. () (XX) e. Provide all necessary materials, tools, gages and instrumentation necessary to perform the required tests. Material and tooling required for the performance testing at Government facility. () (XX) f.
